hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 ≤ C. In that case use the existing proof. Otherwise C ≤ 0; choose B = 0. Since r ≥ 1 and α, δ > 0, their product inverses and all natural powers are nonnegative, including when N = 0. Thus both minima and every factor multiplying C are nonnegative. Repeated use of mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg gives left-hand side ≤ 0, while the right-hand side is zero. This also handles C = 0.
